content.text: Lee Thompson Young starred in the Disney Channel series The Famous Jett Jackson, which was primarily filmed in Brooklin, Ontario, Canada, from 1998 to 2001. He was my age [29] when he took his life on August 19, 2013. He was found in his Los Angeles apartment with a self-inflicted gunshot wound after failing to show up for filming on the set. ❤️‍🩹I honestly feel like if he was still alive he would’ve been in an episode of Atlanta and in one of Ryan Coogler’s moviesCoolest kid on Johnny tsunamiFeel like he would’ve been huge. He’s got such a great energy. Rip!He was my favourite character in Rizzoli&Isles 😢I ran into Lee and @jayhernandez001 on 6th St in Austin, Texas back when they were filming Friday Night Lights. I was a huge Jett Jackson fan- I asked him "hey do you know what time it is ?" to get his attention.They both ended up being so nice- we ended up all hanging out & went to a friends house party together. Nothing weird or creepy just totally hanging out like friends. It was one of the coolest moments of my young life. Such a tragic loss. 💔Disney needs to revive this show! It was super underrated! RIP Lee Thompson Young..Mental Health is so important.Man I loved this show growing up and seeing him on screen- even in Smallville! Talk about representation. I hate that it’s almost impossible to find anywhere! Gone too soonLee I didn’t understand then and still don’t but you are missed 😢Childhood crush❤️ Always thought he was so damn handsome. RIP❤️He couldve been a dope Black PantherDepression and mental health as a whole are real.
